dragon_skull_totem.summary: Chunky dual monster totem composed of an upper dragon head, a central flame conduit, and a lower horned skull.
dragon_skull_totem.pose: The elder dragon head leans forward over the burning demon skull, exhaling a continuous molten flame pillar into its jaw.

curved_ram_horn.summary: Thick segmental curved horn tapering downward and curling inward.

feathered_flame_flick.summary: Spiky clustered pillar of flame tongues carved as low poly cones and boxes.

dorsal_crest_fin.summary: Pointed serrated obsidian pillar stepping sharply upward in jagged plates.

calcined_bone_pile.summary: Cluster of burnt off-white skull fragments and charred horn shards.

glowing_ember_vent.summary: Fissured volcanic slab brimming with incandescent yellow molten core.

things.text: Drake-scale ash, still glowing from the crevasse floor.
